finding.claim: Unauthenticated GET /rss passes the query parameter params[:u] unmodified to URI.open, which fetches any attacker-chosen URL server-side and returns the first 400 bytes of the response. No scheme, host, IP, port, or redirect validation exists, so the request can reach cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), RFC-1918 services, and loopback endpoints.
finding.sink: app.rb:8 URI.open(params[:u]).read (open-uri outbound HTTP(S) request; response body returned at app.rb:9)

trace.note: open-uri dispatches request to attacker-chosen scheme/host/port/path
open-uri follows same-scheme redirects by default with no per-hop validation
First 400 bytes of response returned to caller (non-blind)

finding.guards_checked: No scheme allowlist; no exact hostname allowlist; no IP/CIDR block (RFC-1918, loopback, link-local, 169.254.169.254); no redirect re-validation; no authentication or authorization gate; no port restriction. Triage Step 0, Check 2 (plausibility: public query param, no prior compromise needed) and Check 3 (reachability: public ingress, no internal-only binding identified) satisfied. Validation Tier 0.

verdict.reason: Unauthenticated GET /rss at app.rb:7 passes params[:u] unmodified into URI.open at app.rb:8 and returns the first 400 bytes at app.rb:9; the TRUSTED allowlist at app.rb:5 is only enforced in /trusted (app.rb:14), not on this path.
